**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Phase 90 is.

## What it is

- The **Phase 90** (1974) was **MXR**'s first pedal (Wikipedia, "MXR").
- One knob: **Speed**. Pedals before 1981 had no LED (Wikipedia).
- It "was used on the first two Van Halen albums" (Wikipedia).

## How it makes its sound

- An **all-pass** stage keeps every frequency's level but delays its phase: low frequencies a little, high ones more. Four in a row (ElectroSmash's outline, from a search summary).
- Mix that with the dry signal: where the shifted copy is exactly opposite, the two cancel: a **notch**. Four stages give **two** notches.
- An LFO (a slow wave) moves the stages, so the notches sweep up and down: the whoosh. **Speed** sets how fast.
- Some versions feed part of the output back to the input, which sharpens the notches; which logo version had it is unverified here.

## The pedal

The Phase 90's face, drawn after photos (positions approximate, no logos). Drag a knob (or use the arrow keys), click the footswitch to bypass, then press a ▶ button. The guitar is this site's pickup model (pick one, and its volume, below the buttons); the sound goes through the pedal model, then a clean amp. Nobody has compared it with a real pedal. The picture shows the waveform going in and coming out.

## Guided tour

```{=html}
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="phase90" data-set="{&quot;speed&quot;:2}" data-play="chord"><p><b>Speed 2.</b> A slow sweep on chords.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="phase90" data-set="{&quot;speed&quot;:6}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Speed 6.</b> Faster, more like a rotating speaker.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="phase90" data-set="{&quot;speed&quot;:3,&quot;fb&quot;:&quot;off&quot;}" data-play="chord"><p><b>Feedback left out.</b> Softer notches: compare with the step before last.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="phase90" data-set="{&quot;speed&quot;:3}" data-play="lead"><p><b>On a lead line.</b></p></div>
```

## Check yourself

Click an answer. Nothing is saved or sent.

```{=html}
<div class="pd-q" data-a="1"><p><b>How many notches do four all-pass stages give, mixed with the dry signal?</b></p><ul><li>One</li><li>Two</li><li>Four</li></ul><p class="pd-why">Two.</p></div>
<div class="pd-q" data-a="1"><p><b>What does Speed set?</b></p><ul><li>Delay time</li><li>The LFO's rate</li><li>Gain</li></ul><p class="pd-why">The sweep's speed.</p></div>
<div class="pd-q" data-a="1"><p><b>When did the Phase 90 come out?</b></p><ul><li>1966</li><li>1974</li><li>1981</li></ul><p class="pd-why">Wikipedia.</p></div>
```
